title: Rufius Festus Avienus, Aratea (Phaenomena) and Descriptio orbis terrae / RU: Авиен, «Явления Арата», «Описание круга земель»
author: Rufius Festus Avienus (fl. c. 350–380)
genre: Didactic poetry: astronomy (after Aratus) and geography (after Dionysius Periegetes)
edition: Soubiran, Budé 1981 (Aratea); Van de Woestijne 1961 (Descriptio). Public-domain Aratea, Breysig 1882: https://archive.org/details/rufifestiavieni00aviegoog; Holder 1887
ru_evidence: Only Ora maritima (Kondratiev, ВДИ 1939 no. 2; simposium.ru/ru/node/10568) and Descriptio excerpts on Scythia and the Caucasus (ВДИ 1949; Античная география 1953). Aratea: none found.
en_evidence: English exists only for Ora maritima (Murphy, Ares; Roller 2021). Open Library shows no English Aratea or Descriptio.
other_translations: French: Aratea (Soubiran, Budé 1981); Descriptio (Despois & Saviot 1843). Spanish and Portuguese versions of Ora maritima.
value: Major 4th-c. pagan didactic poetry combining Stoic-Neoplatonic theology, astronomy and geography; reception of Aratus and Dionysius, and a model for medieval cosmography. For literary historians and historians of science.
ai_feasibility: medium: dense verse and star nomenclature. The Greek models (Aratus, Dionysius) and the Latin versions of Cicero and Germanicus allow line-by-line control.
pilot_unit: Descriptio orbis terrae complete (1,393 lines, est. 9k words), or the Aratea proem plus the first c. 300 lines
